title: VanillaPixels
description: A vanilla-friendly texture enhancement pack that improves clarity, detail, and aesthetics while preserving the original Minecraft style.
body:
![VanillaPixelsLogo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4a21aed06cf152ca8eeb1648013b489e845cecf_0.webp)

## _This pack is made to make Minecraft cooler and nicer without sacrificing the **iconic** vanilla-aesthetic!_



You are looking towards features like improved item & block textures, but you don't think the interface changes are something for you? Download my other pack: **[Plain & Precious!](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/plainandprecious)**

For just the user interface update go download: **[Round Up!](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/roundup)**
